scope.objective: Acquire the eight approved Sentinel products into verified non-Git custody and build a reproducible pre-event optical and radar baseline in EPSG:32645.
planned_actions_after_exact_activation: perform a fresh storage and path preflight
create the external custody root and append-only intake records
use an owner-controlled existing Copernicus Data Space account or authenticated session
download only the eight exact approved products
compute local SHA-256 and verify available provider checksums
validate archive integrity, bands, AOI pixels, rights, and coverage
build and QA pre-event optical and radar reference layers
quantify alignment after projection to EPSG:32645
forbidden_until_exact_activation: use credentials or private account sessions
download or extract full satellite products
always_separately_gated: use or redistribute restricted high-resolution imagery
publish scientific conclusions, event attribution, or emergency guidance
store raw imagery, rasters, geodatabases, or ArcGIS packages in Git
stop_conditions: login, multi-factor authentication, or account recovery requires owner action
new or changed terms require acceptance
any product identity, size, checksum, entitlement, or access route differs from this plan
available free space falls below the recorded planning minimum
a download redirects to an unapproved provider or paid route

handoff.next_action: Owner reviews the exact M2 activation bundle. No M2 data action is authorized while this contract remains proposed.
do_not_carry_forward: Catalog byte counts are provider metadata and may differ from transferred or extracted sizes.
The 60 GiB minimum is a conservative planning estimate, not a scientific requirement or capacity guarantee.
No full-product bytes are in custody and no acquisition has begun.
The approved source dispositions do not establish pixel usability, co-registration, radar geometry, or event change.
The post-event optical route remains high-cloud-risk and may be inconclusive after mask review.
